description: Maria Chabot's personal reactions to and descriptions of Hispanic people she knew and observed."Jose Abeyta", "Bernie" [Bernice Martinez, see also: General correspondence], "Mr. Esquimilla", ["Manuel"], Untitled, ["Mike, Mrs. Mike, and Rachel"].
